explanation: Carry the remaining target down each root-to-leaf path in a signed 64-bit integer. Subtract the current value, accept a leaf exactly when the remainder is zero, and reject a missing subtree. Wide intermediate arithmetic prevents signed 32-bit wraparound from creating a false path match.
timeComplexity: O(n) worst-case time for n tree nodes.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursive traversal space for tree height h.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C++ implementation, independently authored from the public EPI problem contract and the repository-authored C# algorithm. Uses the unchanged local EPI Judge serialization and test framework APIs; upstream reference sources are not modified.
